speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, have you noticed any changes in the color of your urine or stool recently? Also, are you experiencing any abdominal pain or nausea?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of high-risk sexual behavior and recent agitation, I need to assess for potential viral hepatitis. Have you experienced any dark urine, pale stools, or fever in the last week? REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests

speaker: Doctor
text: These labs indicate severe acute liver injury with synthetic dysfunction. To pinpoint the cause, have you had any recent unprotected sexual contact with new partners, or do you use intravenous drugs? REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the hepatitis panel is normal, we must look for other causes of acute liver failure. Have you taken any acetaminophen, prescribed medications, or consumed alcohol in large quantities recently? REQUEST TEST: Acetaminophen_Level

speaker: Doctor
text: With viral and toxic causes ruled out, I suspect an autoimmune etiology given your demographics and severe synthetic dysfunction. Have you experienced any joint pain, rashes, or other systemic symptoms recently? REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_Serology

speaker: Doctor
text: With viral, toxic, and autoimmune causes ruled out, I suspect acute Budd-Chiari syndrome or another vascular etiology given the severe synthetic dysfunction. REQUEST TEST: Doppler_Ultrasound_of_Liver

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal ultrasound, I need to rule out other metabolic or genetic causes. Do you have a family history of liver disease, or have you taken any herbal supplements, energy drinks, or recreational drugs other than cocaine and ecstasy recently? REQUEST TEST: Ceruloplasmin_Level

speaker: Doctor
text: With common causes ruled out, I need to assess for acute liver failure due to other viral etiologies like HSV or VZV, or potential ischemic hepatitis. Have you had any recent fevers, mouth ulcers, or skin lesions, and were you ever hypotensive or dehydrated? REQUEST TEST: Viral_PCR_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal viral panel and severe liver injury with agitation, I need to rule out acute Wilson's disease despite the normal ceruloplasmin, as it can present with neuropsychiatric symptoms. REQUEST TEST: Urine_Copper_Excretion

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Liver Failure due to Undetermined Etiology
